audience: support teams that answer customer tickets in a self-hosted Faveo Helpdesk

useCases.title: Find the tickets no agent has taken yet
useCases.text: List the open tickets that no agent has taken yet. Read the thread of a ticket to see what the customer wrote.

useCases.title: Summarize what a customer wants
useCases.text: Get one ticket with its status, owner and department. Read its thread and summarize what the customer asks for.

useCases.title: Find the tickets of one customer
useCases.text: Search the customers by name or email. Then search the tickets by text or ticket number to find that customer's cases.

useCases.title: Reply to a customer ticket
useCases.text: Read the thread of a ticket, then post a reply as the logged-in agent. Faveo emails the reply to the customer.

useCases.title: Open a ticket for a customer
useCases.text: Look up the help topic, SLA plan and priority ids, then create a ticket for the customer. Faveo may email the customer.
